narrative.details:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, champion.
narrative.objectives: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you again, Reli. I've been aquatinting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. As a sky-touched shen'dorei elf traveling through horde territory, I can certainly understand how easily intolerance and prejudice can take root.You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
